results.description: Build a transactional event-sourced inventory engine with concurrency, idempotency, replay, and tamper detection

metrics.finalText:
The production-quality event-sourced inventory engine has been implemented as specified.

### Implementation Overview

- **Storage & Event-Log ([`src/store.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/store.ts))**:
  - Manages linear sequence of events and per-SKU histories.
  - Implements deterministic SHA-256 event hashing and newline-terminated JSONL export/import formatting.
  - Performs comprehensive log validation in `parseAndValidateLog()` covering JSON syntax, positions, stream versions, hash link integrity, duplicate command IDs, manifest metadata, and state transition invariants.

- **Domain Engine ([`src/engine.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/engine.ts))**:
  - Encapsulates inventory state transitions (`create-sku`, `receive`, `reserve`, `release`, `ship`).
  - Enforces string trimming and positive integer validations.
  - Enforces optimistic concurrency (`expectedVersion` matching current SKU state version, throwing [`ConcurrencyError`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/types.ts#L1)).
  - Implements exact idempotency, caching execution results per `commandId` and throwing [`ValidationError`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/types.ts#L8) on command ID reuse with differing inputs/options.
  - Provides atomic multi-SKU transactional batch processing (`executeBatch`), discarding all uncommitted state changes and events if any item fails.
  - Supports deep immutability by deep cloning all inputs, returned states, execution results, and history arrays via `structuredClone`.
  - Supports stream replay and continuation after `InventoryEngine.fromLog()`.

- **Hash & Types ([`src/hash.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/hash.ts), [`src/types.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/types.ts))**:
  - Implements deterministic alphabetical key-sorted canonical representation for SHA-256 hash chaining.
  - Defines error classes and public TypeScript types.

- **Public Exports ([`src/index.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/src/index.ts))**:
  - Re-exports `InventoryEngine`, `ConcurrencyError`, `ValidationError`, and all command/state/event/result/option types.

- **Tests ([`test/inventory.extended.test.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-04-agy-gemini-3-6-medium-122956/workspaces/agy/run-1/event-sourced-inventory/test/inventory.extended.test.ts))**:
  - Added test coverage for input validation, exact idempotency, multi-SKU atomic rollback, intra-batch optimistic concurrency, deep immutability, JSONL hash chaining, tampered log rejection, log continuation, and reservation map cleanup.

### Verification

- Passed `npm run typecheck` cleanly.
- Passed `npm test` (all contract and extended tests passed).
